resources.string: Den-Watcher
Sends this phone\'s usage to your Den-Watcher hub whenever the phone is on your home Wi-Fi.
Pairing code
On the hub\'s page, open Devices, add a device of the kind Phone and enter this code.
Hub\'s address
Tap Scan hub code and point the camera at the code the hub\'s page shows under Devices when you add the phone.
No hub yet
Locked by the hub, so this phone keeps sending to it and recording cannot be stopped. To change that, the hub\'s owner taps Allow changing the hub for this phone under Devices on the hub\'s page.
The hub allows scanning another hub\'s code or stopping recording until %1$s.
Scan hub code
Point the camera at the code on the hub\'s page
This code holds no hub\'s address. Scan the one under Devices on the hub\'s page.

The hub refused the usage. Is it running Den-Watcher 3.5.0 or newer?
Battery
Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery. If the hub misses hours, let Den-Watcher run without battery restrictions.
Battery settings
What is sent
The battery\'s charge and temperature, memory and storage used, and the traffic of Wi-Fi and mobile data, only to the hub on your network. Android lets no app read how busy the processor is.
Recording
Shown while the app records the usage, as Android asks for.
Recording this phone\'s usage
Hub reached on another network
The hub answered on %1$s, not on your usual network. If you are not at home, another device may have the hub\'s address here and get this phone\'s usage.
It\'s my network too
Other networks
When the hub answers on a network other than the usual one.
